vendors.name: NVIDIA
vendors.basis: Production driver baseline for Vulkan 1.4 and Host Image Copy. Developer beta branches are not covered by this advisory.

vendors.name: AMD
vendors.basis: First documented Windows Host Image Copy feature branch. Other branches with the same Adrenalin release name can have older Windows driver versions. This is an update advisory, not a hardware support determination.

vendors.name: Intel
vendors.basis: A Windows driver minimum covering both Vulkan 1.4 and Host Image Copy has not been verified. Never label an Intel driver outdated using an invented cutoff.
